Read the detailed advertisement carefully and click "Apply Online" for the post.
Register online by clicking "Click here to Register Online"; note your Registration Number and Password sent via email/SMS.
Upload your scanned photograph, signature, live photo capture, left thumb impression, and handwritten declaration as per the specified format and size.
Fill in all required details in the online application form carefully; ensure names match your certificates exactly.
Click "COMPLETE REGISTRATION" and take a printout of the submitted application form for your records.
Submit the application on or before 14 September 2026.

content_sections.heading: IOB Security Guard Vacancy 2026 (Category-wise)
content_sections.text: Note: Vacancies are reserved exclusively for Ex-Servicemen/Ex-Agniveers (excluding Disabled Ex-Servicemen). This post is not identified for reservation under the Persons with Disabilities (PWD) category. The number of vacancies is provisional and may vary as per the Bank's actual requirements; reserved-category candidates may also apply against General category vacancies if otherwise eligible.

content_sections.heading: IOB Security Guard Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Candidate must be an Ex-Servicemen/Ex-Agniveer from the Army, Navy, or Air Force, as per the eligibility definitions in this notification. Candidates still serving in the Armed Forces whose Specific Period of Engagement (SPE) completes on or before 30 September 2026 are also eligible to apply. content_sections.heading: IOB Security Guard Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection is in three stages: Online Objective Test, Local Language (Tamil) Test, and Physical Fitness Test. Conducted separately for a maximum of 20 marks . The overall cut-off scores for General and Reserved category candidates in the Online Test and Local Language Test will be decided by the Bank based on candidates' performance. Push-Ups/Sit-Ups: 30+ reps = 30 marks, 21–29 reps = 25 marks, 15–20 reps = 20 marks, 14 or below = Fail. 1 km Run: under 4 min = 30 marks, 4–5 min = 20 marks, 5–6 min = 10 marks, over 6 min = Fail. Candidates must compulsorily pass each of the four Physical Fitness sub-tests with the minimum prescribed marks; only one attempt is allowed per sub-test. Candidates must submit a medical fitness certificate (not older than 15 days) from a Civil Assistant Surgeon or above, prior to the Physical Fitness Test. The Physical Fitness Test will be conducted at IOB Central Office, Chennai. Selection Criteria: The final merit list is drawn by adding marks from the Objective Test, Local Language Test, and Physical Fitness Test, prepared category/reservation-wise. Merely meeting the eligibility criteria does not entitle a candidate to be called for the Online Test or Physical Fitness Test.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IOB Security Guard Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Important: Only online applications are accepted; no other mode will be entertained. If a candidate uploads more than one application, only the latest one will be considered. There is no application fee for this recruitment.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required (at Physical Fitness Test)
content_sections.text: Printout of the valid Physical Fitness Test call letter System-generated printout of the online application form Proof of Date of Birth (Birth Certificate or SSLC/Std. X certificate with DOB) Photo Identity Proof (Passport/Aadhaar/e-Aadhaar/PAN Card/Driving Licence/Voter's Card) Mark sheets and certificates for educational qualifications Discharge Book Ex-Servicemen Identity Card SC/ST/OBC/EWS certificate in the prescribed format, where applicable (OBC certificate must carry the Non-Creamy Layer clause, valid as on 14 September 2026) Any other relevant documents supporting eligibility Ration Card and Learner's Driving Licence are not accepted as valid ID proof for this process. All documents must be produced in original along with a self-attested photocopy; failure to do so may disqualify the candidate from further participation.

content_sections.heading: Important Conditions
content_sections.text: Only candidates willing to work in shifts (24x7x365) should apply. Pre-Examination Training is available (free of cost) for SC/ST/Minority Communities/Ex-Servicemen candidates at Chennai; travel, boarding and lodging expenses must be borne by the candidate. Candidates serving in Government/Quasi-Government/PSU/Nationalised Bank roles must produce an original NOC from their employer at the time of interview/selection stage. Candidates found using unfair means, impersonation, or canvassing will be disqualified and may be debarred from future Bank recruitment, in addition to facing criminal prosecution. Appointment is provisional and subject to medical fitness, and satisfactory verification of character, antecedents, and caste certificates (wherever applicable). No request for change of examination centre, Physical Fitness Test date, or registered email ID will be entertained. Any dispute arising from this recruitment is subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of courts at Chennai. The Bank reserves the right to change the selection procedure, cancel, or stall the recruitment process, partially or fully, at any stage.

faq.question: Q1. Who can apply for IOB Security Guard Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Only eligible Ex-Servicemen and Ex-Agniveers (excluding Disabled Ex-Servicemen) can apply; this is not open to civilian candidates.

faq.question: Q2. How many Security Guard posts has IOB notified?
faq.answer: IOB has notified 25 posts – GEN-12, OBC-7, SC-4, EWS-2, ST-0.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for IOB Security Guard Recruitment 2026?
Q4. What is the selection process for IOB Security Guard?
faq.answer: An Online Objective Test (80 marks), a Local Language Test in Tamil (20 marks), and a Physical Fitness Test (100 marks), followed by a reservation-wise merit list.

faq.question: Q5. What is the pay scale for IOB Security Guard?
faq.answer: ₹19,500–₹37,815 in the Subordinate Staff Cadre, with basic pay fixed based on last drawn defence salary.

faq.question: Q6. Is there an application fee for IOB Security Guard Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. Is knowledge of Tamil compulsory for this post?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates must be able to speak, read and write in Tamil, and this is tested separately in the Local Language Test.

faq.question: Q8. What is the age limit for IOB Security Guard Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: 18 to 26 years for General category (as on 01 August 2026), with relaxation for the actual period of defence service plus 3 years, subject to a maximum of 45 years for Ex-Servicemen across all categories.
